name: Hunan Lead Power Technology Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Hunan Lead Power Technology Group Co., Ltd. engages in the research, production, and sales of surface engineering chemicals in China. It operates through Surface Engineering Chemicals Business and New Energy Battery Business segments. The Surface Engineering Chemicals Business segment include coating additives and intermediates, which are used in automotive, machinery, electronic materials, and other industries. The New Energy Battery Business segment offers cells, modules, and system integration.
